About Strand Notes

Strand Notes is a small independent site about hair dryers, stylers, brushes and care products for people aged 18 to 28. Each guide explains what a tool is for, who it suits and what to skip.

How we choose

  • We read specs, brand documentation and verified buyer reviews.
  • We say so when we have not tested a product ourselves.
  • Nobody pays for a place in a guide.
  • We show no prices, because they change daily.
  • We make no medical or hair-growth claims.

Contact

Email hello@example.com. We cannot give medical or scalp-condition advice.

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Strand Notes is independent and not affiliated with the brands it covers.
